chunks: Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him) used to say: What consoles my soul regarding the swiftness of death and killing among us
is the saying of God: 'Do they not see that We come to the earth reducing it from its sides?'
And it is the departure of the scholars.

key_terms.ذهاب العلماء: The departure/loss of scholars — their death diminishes the world as land shrinks from its edges
key_terms.يسخي نفسي: Consoles/makes generous my soul — an idiom for finding inner peace and acceptance

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Zayn al-Abidin say about the death of scholars in al-Kafi?
ai.summary: Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn (Zayn al-Abidin, peace be upon him) drew comfort from Quran 13:41 when contemplating the frequent martyrdom and premature deaths of the Imams and those associated with them. He interpreted 'reducing the earth from its sides' as the loss of scholars — the learned custodians of divine guidance — whose deaths diminish the spiritual and intellectual landscape of the world. This exegesis reflects the Shia theological understanding that the Imams and their devoted scholars are the pillars by which the earth is sustained.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from the one who mentioned it, from Jabir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> am generous with myself<sup>asws</sup> regarding the hastening of the death and the murder. Regarding us<sup>asws</sup>
are the Words of Allahazwj [13:41] Do they not see that We Aim at the earth by Reducing its sides?
And it is the departure of the scholars<sup>asws</sup> (from the world)’.
en.sarwar: 6. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Ali from the person who he mentioned from Jabi from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following. “Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn (a.s.) would say, ‘My soul shows generosity in accepting the quickening of our death or being murdered.
It is due to the words of Allah that say, “Have they not considered that We have taken over the land and reduced its borders?”
the reference here is to the death of the scholars.”
